title: Optimal antiPlatelet Therapy for High Bleeding and Ischemic RISK Patients Trial

sections.abstract: Current guidelines recommend that patients with ACS undergoing stent implantation might be offered extended DAPT treatment for up to 30 months if necessary. Therefore, we designed a prospective, multicenter, randomized, placebo-controlled trial among ACS patients with high-risk on ischemic and bleeding who received a new generation of DES and received 9 to 12 months of DAPT, and evaluated whether clopidogrel monotherapy reduce the risk of bleeding compared with clopidogrel plus ASA in the following 9 months and achieved non-inferior outcomes in preventing ischemic risk.
